projectTitle: sqllens - SQL Parser, Analyzer & Column Lineage for TypeScript
description: TypeScript SQL parser and analyzer: AST, type inference, column lineage. Error-tolerant for editors and LSP. Databricks, T-SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Postgres, DuckDB, Trino, SQLite, MySQL.
rules: Every parse/analyze/tokenize call takes a dialect string, e.g. 'snowflake', 'tsql', 'databricks'
An inferred type of 'unknown' means no inference rule exists for that function; do not substitute a guessed type
parse() and analyze() never throw on broken SQL; read the returned diagnostics instead of wrapping in try/catch
For editors or repeated edits to the same SQL, use SqlSession/SqlDocument instead of re-calling analyze()
